title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask-wearing among their social neighbors and update their propensity to wear masks based on observed norms and their susceptibility.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Authority issues mandates or guidance; people decide whether to comply given enforcement level, fines, trust, and personal compliance propensity.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers if inventory is available and their mask stock is below a threshold, subject to price and income constraints.

interactions.name: supply_coordination
interactions.description: Authority influences retailer supply via restocking priorities or subsidies to alleviate shortages.

interactions.name: location_attendance
interactions.description: People move between locations (home, work, store, public spaces) where mask requirements may apply and enforcement occurs.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate on the last day of the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a configurable adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: compliance_under_mandate
metrics.description: Average fraction of people complying with mask mandates while mandates are active.

metrics.name: masks_sold_over_time
metrics.description: Daily count of masks sold by retailers.

metrics.name: shortage_frequency
metrics.description: Share of days with at least one retailer experiencing stockouts.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_gini
metrics.description: Gini coefficient of mask adoption across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: policy_effect_lift
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rate before and after policy activation, controlling for trend.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum daily adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: average_cost_per_person
metrics.description: Average cumulative spending on masks per person.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Moving average change in adoption rate is below 0.5% over the last 7 days.

validation_criteria.name: no_negative_inventory
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory remains non-negative throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: threshold_reached_if_configured
validation_criteria.description: If a target adoption threshold is set, the model should report the time_to_threshold or indicate not reached by simulation end.
